status: Read-only production-driver review; evidence/test updates only; no hardware execution
findings: No production-driver behavioral mismatch found in the reviewed RCC/FLASH/basic GPIO/IWDT/UART/SPI/classic-I2C contracts.
L011 own manual confirms stopped-HSI calibration is required, not merely conservative borrowing from L010.
L011 own manual confirms hardware LSI requests need not set software LSIEN.
SPI SMP is approximately 20 ns; the HalfPeriod API remains unsupported on this IP.
GPIO AF tables allocate full nibbles but define only AF0–AF7; SDK/PAC model three bits and HAL preserves the fourth. Do not describe the manual as explicitly marking that fourth bit reserved.
GPIO reset-table/interrupt-mask questions, EXTI and ISR access changes are handled by the separate GPIO/EXTI review.
Electrical bounds and package bonding remain based on the own datasheet; manual review does not establish measured timing.
